narrative.overview: EssayKeys is a pure-white typing surface with no decorative layer between the person and the essay. Structure comes from spacing and hairline rules; the yellow current-character signal is the only visual emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Every page and control shares a pure-white background.
Black text and hairline rules replace cards and shadows.
English essay text carries the visual identity.
Yellow appears only at the current typing position.

rules.name: The One Background Rule
rules.body: Page, header, typing and sound-picker backgrounds all remain pure white.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Yellow belongs only to the current character.

rules.name: The Rule Before Box Rule
rules.body: Use whitespace and hairline separators before introducing a container.

dos: Keep article choices and sound choices as open rows.
Keep touch targets at least 44px tall.
Keep the current character visible and unmistakable.
Keep mobile scrollWidth equal to the viewport width.
donts: Do not reintroduce paper-tinted page backgrounds.
Do not add card shadows, gradients, decorative circles or rounded feature panels.
Do not repeat the product name or add decorative counters.
Do not let navigation chrome compete with essay content.
